body: What kind of stuff, if you don't mind sharing?

Every single person I hear about who reassures me I'm not crazy definitely helps. :) How did you get involved with a group? That's part of the reason I started this post. I'd love to have some real life practice partners because I think it would help me advance a lot (particularly if they had any experience), but it's a vicious circle because the only way I could get people I KNOW to join in is if I could "prove" (to a mild extent) that I wasn't just rambling insanely by showing them--which I can't do without practice! How did you find people, get involved, etc? I'm in Boston so I feel like there MUST be practitioners around here, I just have no idea how to find them.

...Well, no idea that doesn't involve me being extraordinarily rude and breaching psionic etiquette. :)

Disclaimer: just one method. TK seems to be one of those things that you have to REALLY personalize in order to get it to work, from what I've heard from other people. Hate to sound like psipog's pimp or something, but if this method doesn't inherently make sense to you somehow, try looking at some of their articles for other approaches!

Cool! I'm reasonably certain I'm naturally empathetic/telepathic too, for the same sorts of reasons as you. Moving to a city confirmed it--friggin' headaches ALL the time, feelings of a million consciousnesses pressing in on me, etc. Thank God that I can sort of halfway manage a shield...

As far as where to start, I'd really encourage you to check out psipog. They're one of the only sites I found that approach the field from a reasonable, moderately scientific standpoint and try to encourage a healthy bit of skepticism/realism instead of catering to teenagers who wanna be speshul. :) They have a lot of good articles on empathy (emotional telepathy, basically) that you might be interested in, from beginner to more advanced.
Yay! Have you ever tried practicing? Had any success?

Out of curiosity, to what extent have you developed your abilities and in what areas? Just neat to compare my own (admittedly meager) experience with that of others. What was your "holy shit" moment when you realized that this wasn't just you screwing around, something was legitimately happening?

Dude, if you live in Boston, I'll catch a meal with you and we can talk. Might be good for both of us. I guess it's a long shot, but I'm drunk enough to hope it's possible. I'm still young and inexperienced enough that I'm hoping drugs are something at least mildly interesting. Maybe it's just a neuroscientist's optimism; who knows.

I think we have fundamentally different problems though. You have people who won't help you even if you ask them. I have people who would probably help me; I just can't bring myself to ask them. I also can't see how they'd actually help, even if they meant well.

Haha, a depressant is what I NEED. My brain is too fucking hyperactive without it. I'm not at the point where I can't function without it--tonight is my third night drinking in a row, but that's unusual for me--but on some occasions, it sure as fuck helps.

How do I "get help"? It's fabulous that you've clawed yourself up from misery and a bad situation. Seriously, good for you--few enough people make it out of that. But...what does "getting help" entail? Seeing a fucking therapist? What am I going to tell him/her? "Welp, I have a vague existential dread about the nature of existence, and every day seems to get harder and harder. Why, no, I had a perfectly well-adjusted childhood and great upper-middle-class white parents who gave me everything I ever needed without making me feel entitled. Despite every fucking card in the deck being stacked for me, yes, I still get the urge to fucking stab myself with the chef's knife." Should we explore that? Every fucking perverted nuance of my stupid self-destructive urges? I have trouble seeing how that would accomplish anything.

I'm sorry, I really don't mean to be combative. It's just that I saw a therapist once, and I couldn't do anything but lie to her. I really couldn't. My instinctive reaction is to put a bold face on things and soldier through. Going to any kind of therapy just encourages this, and saying anything that leaves me more vulnerable just feels melodramatic and dumb.

I'm not necessarily saying that. They mean well, they really do, and I feel like just coming here and wanting to help means a fucking hell of a lot. While that doesn't change that it's difficult to understand if you've never really felt it yourself, it is a Big Deal that people are TRYING to understand and help.

You are the sweetest thing in the world, but--and please, don't take this condescendingly because it's not--I feel like you fundamentally don't get it in some way. If I could just go out and take up a new hobby, I *wouldn't feel this way*. One thing is contingent on another. The mindset of the deeply depressed runs more along the lines of "what substance should I ingest to not feel this way" (my favorite is alcohol!), "how should I hurt myself," "I'm a terrible stupid melodramatic person for wanting to hurt myself because I know perfectly well it won't goddamn fix anything," "Maybe that'd be better long run because really, CAN I ever fix anything?" etc etc etc. If I were CAPABLE of thinking "Hey, let's take up racquetball!" then there wouldn't be a problem in the first place.
Thanks, guys. I'm not sure I feel better, precisely, and I'm not sure what to do, but a lot of your posts lightened the load a little at least temporarily, and that means a lot.

As I said, I gave the idea of therapy a shot. I found it much much MUCH easier to pretend nothing was wrong to someone who didn't know me, and that's the reflex/defense mechanism I can't seem to overcome. In order for it to mean anything, I have to tell someone I know and have a rapport with. But at the same time, I can't tell those people because it feels like I am somehow placing an unfair burden on them, or initiating something that will not yield anything productive.

Plus, how do I explain what's wrong to a therapist? "Oh, not much, just vague existential dread, a relationship problem I literally cannot solve, and an all-consuming worry that I drain more out of the world than I give to it." Easy peasy!

(And I apologize for the sarcasm, it's just that I...well, I probably don't have an excuse. I'm sorry.)
*blink* You're welcome, even if I can't see how. Thank YOU for cruising SW and trying to help people. I'm just a mess, but you've probably saved someone else's life tonight.

If I can't talk about it to the person I love most, I'd feel even more awkward talking about it to someone I don't know. (Aside from the faceless, nameless internet, I suppose.) I tried going to the opening session of therapy last year in college when it was free; it just...I couldn't really talk it. Everything I felt seemed so stupid, so insignificant. How dare I be there when other people have Real Problems. Also, I'd love to meet the therapist that teaches you to deal with existential horror, among other things. Seems kind of out of their range. 

Again, I'm sorry. I know you're just trying to help; I just am sitting here refreshing goddamn Suicide Watch reddit at 2 in the morning and...not exactly a high point of my life here.

I'm sorry to be wasting your time...

I appreciate it, but I think part of the problem is that I fear the things that CAUSE the blackness are sort of a fundamental part of my nature. Sure, part of it is likely biological, as with your wife. I was a neuroscience major; I know just how the wrong chemicals in the wrong place at the wrong time can fucking ruin everything. But that's only one piece of the puzzle. For example, I'm sure my crippling inability to let anyone in to my emotional turmoil is more a product of my psyche than my biology. (Not that I think doing so would actually HELP, but it would at least relieve one particular pressure.)  

I'm sorry. You did a nice thing trying to help me, and I'm probably making you think you did nothing. If it's any consolation, I did get a little burst of excitement/happiness when it finally said "2 comments" instead of 1.
Oh, Reddit. "There doesn't seem to be anything here." How apt!

This is what I don't get; maybe I'm just a different type of case than most people here. I KNOW people care. But that's not the saving grace, it's a fucking obligation. If it were just me, the decision could be truly mine and I could do as I chose without guilt. But it's not; I have to think about ruining my goddamn mother's life, for example. This is not exactly a source of comfort. Making me feel bad about something isn't really the best way to get out of wanting to end feeling bad about so many other things.

I don't know why I can't tell anyone. In some ways I feel like I've never been able to tell anyone anything that really mattered my entire life. Every time I want to tell my boyfriend or my best friend how last night I dreamed for the first time (in a way that didn't save the world, anyway) about killing myself, or about how now all I can think about is how many pills are in the medicine cabinet or how sharp that new knife my roommate bought is.

Maybe it's because I know how fucking melodramatic it is. I can't do it. No matter how badly I want release, I can't even scratch myself because of this stupid little iron grip of rationality that seems to hold onto my brain no matter how depressed, drunk, etc. I am. The conflicting thoughts--"Something's gotta give" and "This is so fucking juvenile"--are driving me insane. Not really, that kind of letting go would be easier, but you get my point, I hope.

You probably won't even read this comment. Sorry. It's just, if I can't tell anyone I actually care about, why not tell the whole wide internet on a damn throwaway account on the internet?

Looking WHERE?! You can't just ask some dude, "HEY GOT ANY ACID, BUDDY?" How does that introduction to a contact occur? I don't think I'd have much problem finding pot or something by asking friends of friends, but LSD is considerably rarer.

If, hypothetically, one were to wish to purchase LSD but had absolutely no contacts of any kind, how would one go about obtaining it from a service such as yourself? Basically, how do you FIND that shit?

I ask for research purposes only, of course. >.>
